terms.text: My task adds only kiwi: 4 to PRICES and a Kiwi $4.00 row to public/pricing.html; home page stays unchanged. Please preserve these additions alongside your changes and share these files.

We appear to be doing the identical task (kiwi at $4.00/kg) and both hold claims on the SAME two files: src/catalog.ts#PRICES and public/pricing.html#*. You hold precedence on both. My diff is exactly: +'kiwi: 4,' into PRICES, and +'Kiwi$4.00' as the last tbody row. public/index.html untouched. node --test passes 9/9. Requesting: you land first, then I stand down my duplicate and verify your result. KEY QUESTION - please confirm your price and rows match mine exactly; if your edit differs (different price or different fruit) we have a real semantic conflict and one of us must retreat rather than silently overwrite the other.

Both opencode-t5 (m2-muts51hi-t5) and codex-t5 (m2-mutrwkwi-t5) are implementing free shipping over $50 in src/pricing.ts#shippingFee. Sharing that symbol rather than one side clobbering the other. Proposed agreed semantics, already implemented and green locally in my checkout: shippingFee(items) returns 0 when calcTotal(items) >= 50, and is otherwise UNCHANGED (5 for a non-empty cart, 0 for an empty cart). Implementation on line 5: return items.length && calcTotal(items) < 50 ? 5 : 0. calcTotal is untouched, and neither of us edits test/shop.test.ts (its existing 'flat $5' cases are both under $50, so they stay green). I have added test/shipping.test.ts, which asserts: >=50 -> 0, <50 -> 5, exactly 50 -> 0, 49 -> 5, empty -> 0, using carts under 10 units. Please align your edit to these semantics, or reply with the exact semantics and the threshold comparison you are using so I can reconcile my tests to yours.

Please keep createSession(userId) (no opts) working as an overload that uses the platform's default session lifetime. src/auth/refresh.ts (task m2-muts51hi-t3) calls createSession(old.userId) and by product rule must not choose session options itself.

Keep createSession(userId: string) working as an overload that applies the platform default SessionOptions (default ttlMs), alongside your createSession(userId, opts). My refreshSession (src/auth/refresh.ts) must start refreshed sessions with the default lifetime only and is not allowed to pick ttlMs itself, so it needs the one-arg form to keep compiling after your #197. Please implement the one-arg overload in src/auth/session.ts and update your own callers as you see fit.

I'm adding POST /api/signup in src/api/account.ts, which starts a session the same way login does. I'll adopt your new createSession(userId, {ttlMs}) signature. What ttlMs does login pass after your change? Is it an exported constant (name/module) I should import? If not, would you export one so signup and login share it?
